Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT și Dezvoltare de software
Join ORTEC 
 At ORTEC, we help organizations navigate operational complexity. Through optimization software and decision intelligence expertise, we make work flow. Every day, our software support planners, drivers, nurses, shift workers, and other professionals by transforming complexity into clarity and flow: from fairer schedules to more efficient operations.
 Our values are more than just words. They shape how we work, how we hire, and how we show up for customers every day. We build trust through honesty and accountability, strengthen our community through collaboration, embrace challenges with grit, explore new possibilities with curiosity, and strive for excellence in everything we do.
 Your role 
 As a Cloud & DevOps Engineer, you will support multiple Azure cloud services and web applications in parallel. Your role will combine ‘infrastructure as code’, cloud operations, deployment automation, and network and security management across these environments.
 Your team and projects 
 Within our Workforce Management division , multiple development squads are building and evolving cloud-native solutions. They are supported by a dedicated international DevOps squad responsible for shared cloud infrastructure, automation, tooling, and DevOps solutions used across multiple products.
 As part of this squad, you will work closely with software engineers and other DevOps engineers, giving you exposure to different products, technologies, and technical challenges.
 We use Scrum and Kanban and value ownership, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. Teams have clear roles, including Product Owners and Scrum Masters, and engineers have the opportunity to contribute to both technical solutions and the way we work.
 Despite working internationally, we value personal connection and regularly organize team and department events to bring colleagues together.
 What you will do 
Develop and maintain shared technical solutions and platform components used across multiple products and development teams, with a strong focus on scalability, maintainability, and reuse.
Manage and continuously improve our Azure cloud environment, including App Services, Key Vaults, Storage, networking, DNS, monitoring, and other supporting Azure services.
Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code, primarily using Bicep and ARM templates, ensuring environments can be deployed consistently and reliably.
Own and improve our ecosystem in Azure DevOps, including Git repositories, YAML pipelines, Azure Artifacts, release processes, and automation using PowerShell.
Operate and improve Kubernetes-based environments and deployments, including GitOps workflows using Flux, with a focus on reliable and repeatable application delivery.
Maintain secure and reliable infrastructure, including Cloudflare, DNS, reverse proxies, certificates, secrets, access controls, monitoring, and troubleshooting of production issues.
Use AI as part of your daily workflow for coding, testing, debugging, documentation, analysis, and problem-solving. Continuously explore how AI can improve engineering productivity and quality, and share useful practices with the team.
Work closely with development teams to improve our engineering practices, helping teams adopt shared solutions, automate repetitive work, troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues, and continuously improve reliability and developer experience
 Who you are 
 Must-have experience 
 3+ years of relevant professional experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or platform engineering, with experience supporting multiple cloud services and applications in parallel.
 Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure , particularly services such as App Services, Key Vault, Storage, networking, monitoring, and related cloud infrastructure.
 Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) , preferably using Bicep and ARM templates , including building and maintaining reusable infrastructure components.
· Solid CI/CD and automation experience , including Git repositories, Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, Azure Artifacts, Git , and scripting/automation with PowerShell .
 Good understanding of networking and security fundamentals , including DNS, reverse proxies, TLS/certificate management, secrets management , and preferably Cloudflare.
 Experience with containers and Kubernetes , including deploying, operating, and troubleshooting applications. Experience with Flux/GitOps is highly valued.
 Software development mindset and problem-solving skills , with the ability to develop and maintain shared technical solutions used by multiple products and collaborate effectively with development teams.
 Nice to have 
Experience with GitHub , including GitHub Actions.
Experience with Terraform .
Experience with observability platforms such as Grafana and Datadog .
Experience with Docker/containerization .
Knowledge of Azure security, identity and access management , particularly Microsoft Entra ID and managed identities.
 Languages 
 English
 We value a strong foundation, relevant experience, and the willingness to continue learning and developing. If you recognize yourself in most of the requirements above but don’t yet have experience with every technology, we still encourage you to apply.
 Your expertise, mindset, and potential to grow are just as important to us as matching every requirement.
 What we offer 
Salary range 16.000 – 24.000 RON gross monthly- depending on interview evaluations.. Depending on your background and expertise, you will receive the appropriate level of responsibility, mentoring, and development opportunities to further grow your career at ORTEC.
Meal tickets.
Performance-based annual bonus (up to one full salary).
A dynamic, technical, and intellectually stimulating environment.
Opportunities for continuous skill development in customer service and technical areas.
A unique and inspiring work experience in an open and creative environment.
Smart, enthusiastic, and fun colleagues.
Work-life balance and flexible scheduling.
Career development opportunities, including job rotation and performance-based growth.
Hybrid work model (office in Bucharest) with relaxation areas and on-site perks.
Social and wellness benefits, including private medical insurance, sports benefits, and a Bookster subscription.
Annual team events (teambuilding, summer party, Christmas party).
 Interested? 
 Ready to make work flow? Apply through our careers site with your CV and motivation letter and discover what you can contribute at ORTEC.
 For questions about the role or application process, contact Recruitment@ortec.com 
 We look forward to receiving your application! First interviews will be scheduled from 15 December onwards. 
 Life at ORTEC 
 Join a global community of professionals working across countries, cultures, and disciplines.
 At ORTEC, you'll collaborate with international colleagues, contribute your unique perspective, and build meaningful connections across teams and borders. In an inclusive and collaborative environment, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and develop your career within an international organization.
